note: Money going out of the Prime Minister Disaster Relief Fund for the Rasuwa–Bhotekoshi flood, and how the receiving agency passed it on. Stage `fund_transfer` is a transfer out of the Fund itself, as the fund status statement records it; stage `onward` is the receiving agency's own disbursement of that money, as its report records it. Every entry names its source document. Add later transfers and disbursements here, in the same shape.
